facts_of_case: The couple have a lovely 10 year old daughter named Akshada. The custody of this child is at the centre of controversy and which has given rise to series of legal battles between the husband and wife.

legal_principles.principle: The question of custody and visitation rights of the child are already decided by the court, and any breach of such an order can be addressed by approaching the same court.
legal_principles.held: Learned Judge was of the opinion that the question of custody and visitation rights of the child were already decided by the learned Civil Judge(SD) in the divorce petition. If there is any breach of such an order, wife has to approach the same Court.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order VII Rule 11

legal_principles.principle: A court may exercise suo motu powers to register a petition and ensure justice is served.
legal_principles.held: Learned Single Judge decided to exercise suo motu powers under Article 227 of the Constitution of India against the said proceedings and register the same as Special Civil Application No. 2031/2009.
use_in: cases where justice is not served by existing procedures

legal_principles.principle: The court may consider the wishes of a minor child in making decisions about their custody and upbringing.
legal_principles.held: Learned Single Judge discarded the wish of the daughter on the ground that minor daughter was suffering from ear-poisoning by the father.

legal_principles.principle: A court may direct a party to admit their child in a particular school or institution.
legal_principles.held: Learned Single Judge directed that daughter be admitted in a school at Vadodara.
